origin.summary: Planning discussion for a Spring Boot MCP controller and annotation framework using HTTPRequest<Query, Params, Body>, class-based middleware, specific availability annotations, route IDs, secrets, startup validation, structured logs, and standard error contracts. Later refined to require exactly three route library modules for the first implementation slice: route API, route annotations, and route framework runtime, without a centralized aggregate module or server-module integration yet.

events.note: Created from planning discussion about final MCP route controller shape and supporting framework scope.
Added recommended lib module structure covering meshingress-route-api, meshingress-route-annotations, and meshingress-route-framework responsibilities.
Constrained the pending implementation shape to three route lib modules only, with no centralized aggregate module and no server-module integration yet.
Implemented and verified the first library-only route framework slice across meshingress-route-api, meshingress-route-annotations, and meshingress-route-framework.
